Players Committee card image of [[Han Solo, Optimistic General]], as first published (no errata mark), printing: “May be targeted instead of a Resistance character by I Want That Map. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Endor] scouts are destiny +1. Cancels Kylo's game text here. During battle with Chewie or [Endor] Leia, may add one destiny to total power.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/han_solo_optimistic_general.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/han_solo_optimistic_general.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
